visualCharacteristics.purpose: Edge-to-edge row of tall portrait photo tiles, each fully linked, with an uppercase label at the bottom
visualCharacteristics.summary: 4-up edge-to-edge tall portrait photo tiles, label overlaid in white uppercase at bottom left, whole tile is a link, hover lift

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 = portrait image (UE fields image + imageAlt); cell 2 = rich text (UE field text) with one link whose text is the tile label. The whole tile becomes clickable
contentPattern.source: get_block_details /block-collection/cards and blocks/cards/_cards.json (child model card: image, imageAlt, text)

cells: Block name plus variant, e.g. Cards (segment)
Rich text (field text): eyebrow paragraph, heading, description, CTA link

usage: Audience/segment navigation tiles (Private Bank, Personal Bank, ...).
reuseGuidance: Use for image-led navigation tiles with a single link label each. For tiles with heading, copy and CTA use cards-product.
